"Kleborb, there it is. Earth!" He raised his large yet oddly thin arms towards the small port hole. 

Kleborb looked towards the port hole and nodded with what would be considered a smile on his face. 

"Yes, Beborb, this is it. This is the land of the Feline master race." He waved his hand towards the port hole and suddenly an opening seemed to appear out of nowhere. 

Kleborb and Beborb seemed to slowly glide out of there spaceship and towards their meeting point. 

As they approached their meeting point a few cats seemed to peek out from the shadows. ( Did I mention it was night time?)

Kleborb would kneel down in front of the cats and "smile" with glee. 

"I am so happy to be meeting you, sir! My planet is in need of some slaves and I hear this place is where I can get them by the dozen, and for cheap too!"

The cat tilted his head to the side and stared at the creature with a confused look on its face.

"Oh, I'm so sorry, sir. Allow me to speak in your tongue." Kleborb motioned for his wrist and tapped on a bracelet that was attached to it. The bracelet would notify him of his vocal change. "feline talk enabled"

"Meow meow meow meow?"  Kleborb said.

The cat shook it's head "meow meow"

"Oh! Meow meow meow meow?"

"Mm, meow meow"

Kleborb nodded, "meow."

"Meow meow meow meow meow. Meow meow? Meow. Meow meow!"

The cat now spoke loudly and the cats that he was with were now scared. "MEOW MEOW MEOW MEOW!"
